name: 5dive-partner
description: The 5dive partner-box plugin, published from its own repository. Installed by the partner box profile only; a regular 5dive box does not carry it.

plugins.name: partner
plugins.description: A partner box's privileged work behind the owner's tap: one sysadmin seat whose only root grant is a broker that reads, restarts, and proposes root scripts the client approves on Telegram.
